description:
MY OWN DEFECT (findings F13). srq1_residual_diagnostics.py ran on IN-SAMPLE residuals (r.resid). 5.3 requires CROSS-VALIDATION residuals: fitted values 'are often not true forecasts because any parameters involved are estimated using all available observations, including future observations.'

The log-scale half was correct and deliberate. Only the CV half is wrong.

Direction of the error: in-sample residuals are optimistically clean, so the true rejection rate is likely HIGHER than the 22.2% recorded, not lower. The verdict ('autocorrelation remains') is probably safe and the +0.361 vs +0.064 seasonal-ACF split is a like-for-like comparison that survives. But the NUMBER must not be cited until this re-runs.

Implement rolling-origin CV residuals per 5.10 and re-run. Lands in the BRANCH B tree, not Branch A's. Free: no retrain, no spend.

G1 stays PROVISIONAL in task_plan.md until this completes.
